Identify daily work requirements and PCB design specifications from the supervisor and Arrange necessary tools like wire cutters, pliers, and soldering irons.

pcs.pc_description: Assemble using pick-and-place machines, perform quality checks with ICT (In-Circuit Testing) and track delivery using ERP systems for traceability.
Select the appropriate PCB assembly process based on design and requirements.
Use high-resolution digital microscopes and soldering/rework stations with temperature control to inspect and fix defects on PCB assemblies accurately.
Inspect and rectify any component placement errors.
Apply flux or solder paste as per requirement before soldering.
Handle sensitive electronic components using anti-static measures.
Inspect the soldering station before starting work to resolve issues.
Solder components onto the circuit board as per SOPs.
Analyze the assembled board using a magnifying glass to check for missing components, incorrect values, or dry soldering.
Conduct functional testing of the PCB assembly to detect soldering errors.
Rework to fix soldering or other identified errors to pass the functional test.
Use automated testing equipment where applicable for quality assurance
Document the quantity and type of assembled components and software used.
Ensure compliance with ESD (Electrostatic Discharge) safety standards.
Maintain traceability records of assembled PCBs for quality audits
Deliver the assembled board to the device assembly team on time
Dispose of defective components and waste materials as per environmental guidelines.
